item.title: Elon Musk has lost his lawsuit against Sam Altman and OpenAI
item.description:
📝 Elon Musk’s claim that he was mistreated by his OpenAI cofounders failed after nine California jurors returned a unanimous verdict that his lawsuits had been filed too late. Jurors, however, found that any harms that Musk may have suffered came before the deadline for filing his claims under the law. Musk’s lawsuit is nothing more than an after the fact contrivance that bears no relationship to reality,” OpenAI’s lead attorney, Bill Savitt, said after the verdict.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/05/18/elon-musk-has-lost-his-lawsuit-against-sam-altman-and-openai/

item.title: Iran starts Bitcoin-backed ship insurance for Hormuz strait
item.description:
📝 Send a tip to our reportersSite feedback:Take our SurveyNew WindowFacebookXLinkedInEmailLinkGiftBy Golnar MotevalliMay 18, 2026 at 12:29 PM UTCUpdated on May 18, 2026 at 3:31 PM UTCBookmarkSaveIran has started a Bitcoin-backed insurance service for Iranian shipping companies that want to transit the Strait of Hormuz, the semi-official Fars news agency reported, citing documents obtained from the country’s Ministry of Economy and Financial Affairs. According to a screen shot of the insurance company’s website, dubbed Hormuz Safe and shared by Fars news, it “provides Iranian shipping companies and cargo owners with fast, verifiable digital insurance. ” Fars didn’t give a detailed break down of how the insurance works and whether it’s available to foreign shipping companies and vessels.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-05-18/iran-starts-bitcoin-backed-shipping-insurance-for-hormuz-strait
